aspects.vizContactsCaption: Filled cell = that slow planet occupies or aspects the natal point today
aspects.ariaContacts: Current transit contacts to natal points
aspects.vizWindowsCaption: ×2 / ×3 = how many slow planets touch the same point together. Gold line = today.
aspects.emptyActiveMulti: No double/triple transit on a natal point right now.
aspects.emptyEvents: No new aspect starts in this window.
aspects.howToBody: Whole-sign Parashara drishti (7th for all; Ju 5/9; Sa 3/10; nodes via 7th). Double/triple means two or more of Ju/Sa/Ra/Ke simultaneously conjunct or aspect the same natal point. Confirm with dasha before acting on any window.

biwheel.title: Bi-wheel · Moorthy · D9
biwheel.moorthyEmpty: Moorthy data unavailable for this date.
biwheel.howToBody: Bi-wheel shows natal grahas inside and transit outside from your D1 lagna. Moorthy uses the weekday of Ju/Sa sign ingress (gold/silver supportive; copper mixed; iron caution). D9 gochar maps the same transit longitudes into Navamsha for marriage/dharma confirmation — pair with dasha.

roadmap.footnote: Tip: use Key shifts for cycle-level changes; switch to Sign, Nakshatra or Pada for precise timing. A transit planet that is also your running dasha lord tends to deliver its theme more strongly.
